pages.text: $(italic)$(#6b5a45)This chapter is the written version of the in-game tutorial. Press V to open the management panel, follow the guide box in the top-right through the five steps below, and
you'll have a town that works on its own;$(br)$()$(br2)$(#6b5a45)$(italic)if you have already done them, skip to the next chapter.$()
Press V to open the management panel, then 1 for the Build tab. Click the Town Hall card and double-click it to start placing: hold right-click and drag to turn the camera, put the building
pages.title: 1. Build the Town Hall

pages.text: where you want it, left-click to rotate it, then confirm with Submit Build and Submit on the right. When construct$(br2)ion finishes the naming screen pops up on its own — give your town a name and you're settled in.
Once construction ends you name the town
Drag with the right button to turn the camera; left click rotates 90 degrees
The warehouse is the town's shared stock: everything mages gather or craft goes in here, and whatever sits in your own inventory doesn't count. The moment it is up, every element gets a sta
pages.title: 2. Build a Warehouse

pages.text: rting amount in there, and that is what you build with. Building it works just like before: pick the Warehouse card$(br2)in the Build tab, double-click, place it, submit.
Leave build mode first (press 1 or ESC), point at the warehouse and right-click once to open it, then switch to the Exchange tab: the warehouse slots are on the left with your inventory und
pages.title: 3. Put Something in the Warehouse

pages.text: The Exchange tab: warehouse on the left, your inventory below

erneath, so clicking an item moves it in, and clicking it again takes it back out. This step is about remembering h$(br2)ow the warehouse opens and how goods move — every haul later on goes through this tab.

The workstation is where the town does its work: mages take a job and get to it right there, so keep it close to the warehouse. You build it in the Build tab as well: pick the Workstation c$(br)ard, double-click, place it, submit.
pages.title: 4. Build a Workstation

pages.text: Right-click the workstation and switch to the Synthesize tab: the ones shown in full colour can be ordered straight away, and the greyed-out ones are not unlocked yet — deposit the item you$(br) want from your inventory into the warehouse and its recipe opens, and the other two unlocking routes are on the $(
pages.title: 5. Queue a Crafting Order

pages.text: The Workstation crafting tab: pick a recipe and submit

l:wandscape:items/blueprint_guide)Item Blueprint$(/l) page. Pick an unlocked recipe and click Submit to put the order into the town's task queue. A mage takes it from there: the materials c$(br)ome out of the warehouse and the output goes back into it — never into your inventory, so don't go looking for it i

n your backpack. To see how far along the job is, press V and then 3 for the task hall. That is the end of the five steps and the guide box won't come back;$(br)for what to build and do next, read $(l:wandscape:playstyle/intro_0_5_guide)《0.5 Recommended Features》$(/l).
